concurrencyCheck.otherOpenPRScope: Observed older content/asset-only M2 PRs; no current same-scope metadata writer identified. Source files remain read-only; proposals are bound to exact baseline.

countSemantics.reviewed: Every item was inspected; unresolved evidence is counted separately and is not accepted metadata.

countSemantics.unresolved: Named metadata fields blocked by insufficient source evidence; proposals cannot be registered as approved.
